title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: MUTOH is actively launching new products (HydrAton printer in 2025, new eco-solvent printers at PRINTING United 2024) and has won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024, indicating strong focus on product innovation and differentiation. The VP of Product Management would be responsible for complete solutions portfolios and ecosystem partnerships. Tedlar represents a premium differentiation opportunity: MUTOH could recommend or bundle Tedlar overlaminates with their wide-format printers for vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and durable graphics applications. This creates a competitive advantage by offering customers a complete durability solution (printer + ink + protective film) that extends graphics lifespan to 12-20+ years, reduces warranty claims on printed output, and positions MUTOH as the premium choice for outdoor applications. This role cares about product portfolio strategy, competitive positioning, customer success metrics, and recurring revenue opportunities through consumables/accessories ecosystems.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As VP of Product Management, [Name] owns MUTOH's entire product portfolio strategy, including printers, inks, and accessories. They decide which complementary products and partnerships to pursue, which solutions to bundle, and how to position MUTOH's offerings against competitors. They likely report directly to the President/CEO and oversee product managers across different printer lines. This role influences purchasing decisions for consumables and accessories that enhance MUTOH's printer value proposition, and they have authority to establish strategic vendor relationships that strengthen customer outcomes.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Given MUTOH's wide-format printers are used for vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, banners, and large-scale graphics, Tedlar's protective film portfolio directly extends the performance of MUTOH's printed output. Specifically: (1) Vehicle wrap overlaminates that protect MUTOH-printed graphics from UV degradation and graffiti, extending wrap lifespan from 3-5 years to 12-20+ years; (2) Outdoor signage overlaminates that prevent fading and cracking on MUTOH-printed signs exposed to weather extremes (-70°F to 230°F); (3) Architectural graphics protection for building wraps and facade applications produced on MUTOH equipment. By recommending or bundling Tedlar, MUTOH transforms from a printer supplier to a complete durability solutions provider, reducing their customers' warranty claims and replacement costs while commanding premium pricing for superior total cost of ownership.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] likely owns product portfolio revenue, product line profitability, customer satisfaction scores (NPS/CSAT), and competitive win rates. Their performance is measured by how effectively MUTOH's products differentiate in the market and drive recurring revenue through consumables. Pain points they care about: (1) Customers experiencing premature failure of graphics printed on MUTOH equipment (even when the failure is due to inadequate overlaminate, it reflects poorly on MUTOH); (2) Competitive pressure from other wide-format printer manufacturers who offer more complete solutions; (3) Limited recurring revenue opportunities beyond ink sales; (4) Difficulty justifying premium pricing without clear performance differentiation. Tedlar directly addresses all four: it reduces failure rates on MUTOH-printed output, creates a complete solution advantage, establishes a new consumables revenue stream through recommended overlaminates, and provides concrete performance data (12-20+ year lifespan, graffiti resistance) to support premium positioning.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: MUTOH is exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) and SEMA Show 2025, presenting prime opportunities for in-person engagement or pre-show outreach. The company just launched new eco-solvent printers at PRINTING United 2024 and is launching the HydrAton printer in 2025, indicating active product development cycles where strategic partnerships can be integrated into go-to-market plans. Their 13 consecutive years of PRINTING United Alliance recognition and four 2024 Pinnacle Product Awards demonstrate strong industry relationships and credibility, making co-marketing with DuPont Tedlar a natural fit. The timing is ideal because [Name] is likely planning 2025-2026 product roadmap and partnership strategies right now, and MUTOH's recent award wins position them to lead with premium solutions rather than compete on price.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH won four Pinnacle Product Awards in 2024 and has launched multiple new printer models, showing aggressive product innovation strategy
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Acknowledge their recent recognition and position Tedlar as the natural next step in their premium solutions strategy. Frame the conversation around complete system differentiation: 'Your printers set the quality standard—Tedlar ensures that quality lasts 12-20+ years in the field.' Appeal to their competitive instinct by highlighting how bundling Tedlar creates a moat that printer-only competitors can't match.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH's end customers (vehicle wrap installers, sign manufacturers) face warranty claims and customer complaints when graphics fail prematurely due to UV damage or graffiti
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as a customer success enabler rather than just a material. Lead with: 'Your customers' biggest risk isn't print quality—it's what happens to their graphics after installation.' Offer data on how Tedlar-protected graphics eliminate the #1 source of warranty claims (UV degradation), making MUTOH's customers more profitable and loyal. Frame this as protecting MUTOH's brand reputation in the field.

personalization_hooks.hook: MUTOH exhibits at both PRINTING United Expo 2025 and SEMA Show 2025, targeting sign/graphics and automotive wrap markets where outdoor performance is critical
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their trade show presence and suggest exploring how Tedlar could enhance their booth demonstrations and customer conversations. Propose: 'What if your SEMA booth showcased not just print quality, but guaranteed 15-year outdoor performance? That's a conversation-stopper.' Offer to provide side-by-side weathering comparisons or case studies for their pre-show customer meetings, positioning this as a joint go-to-market opportunity at their most important industry events.

recommended_approach: Lead with product portfolio strategy and competitive differentiation, not material specs. Frame Tedlar as a strategic partner that elevates MUTOH's entire value proposition from 'excellent printers' to 'complete outdoor graphics systems.' Open by acknowledging their recent product awards and innovation momentum, then pivot to the question: 'How do you ensure your customers' printed output performs as well in year 10 as it does in week 1?' Position the conversation as exploring a partnership that creates recurring revenue, reduces customer churn from performance failures, and establishes clear daylight between MUTOH and printer-only competitors. Request a brief exploratory call to discuss portfolio strategy, not a product pitch meeting.
